Model backend confirmed: 'partner-powered AI features use models hosted by Azure OpenAI service, OpenAI on Databricks, or Anthropic on Databricks'; fallback confirmed: 'When partner-powered AI features are disabled, AI assistive features use Databricks-hosted models' using 'open-source models that are available for commercial use, such as OpenAI GPT OSS.' Regulated data requires enabling the compliance security profile (PHI/PCI/IRAP/FedRAMP). Suitability personal=cfg / special=no remains correct under the canonical rule (pure vendor cloud).
